title: Fear and Anxiety
definition: Fear and anxiety are experiences of worry, uncertainty, dread, or distress that can affect the mind, emotions, body, and spiritual life. Scripture calls believers to bring their fears before God rather than be ruled by them.
summary: Believers can bring fear and anxiety honestly before the God who cares for them.
christFocus: Jesus repeatedly called people to trust the Father. Through His presence, promises, and peace, Christ strengthens believers who struggle with fear and anxiety.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Fear is a common human experience in a fallen world. Concerns about health, finances, family, safety, the future, and suffering can easily overwhelm the heart. Scripture does not shame believers for experiencing fear; instead, it repeatedly points them toward God's faithfulness, presence, and care. While anxiety may remain a difficult battle for some, believers are invited to bring every concern before the Lord and trust Him day by day.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Fear can become a prison that controls decisions, steals joy, weakens faith, and isolates people from others. Understanding God's character helps believers replace panic with trust and uncertainty with hope.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: When fear rises, bring specific concerns to God in prayer. Fill your mind with Scripture rather than worst-case scenarios. Seek support from trusted believers and remember that courage is not the absence of fear—it is choosing to trust God in the middle of it.
